description: Frontend runtime config: add absoluteApiBase() helper to api.js that reads window.__APP_CONFIG__.API_BASE_URL first; create frontend/public/config.js; update index.html to load config.js before the app bundle; update OverviewPage.jsx and ApiKeysPage.jsx to call absoluteApiBase() instead of inline env var expressions; update frontend/.env.example to contain only VITE_API_BASE_URL. Independent of FEAT-001.
steps: Read frontend/src/lib/api.js in full before changing it.

In frontend/src/lib/api.js: add an exported function absoluteApiBase() that returns (window.__APP_CONFIG__?.API_BASE_URL || import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || 'http://localhost:8000').replace(/\/$/, ''). Replace the module-level BASE_URL constant with a call to absoluteApiBase() — or make BASE_URL a getter if it must remain a constant name. Because BASE_URL is only used inside apiFetch and the legacy request() function, the simplest change is: replace `const BASE_URL = ...` with `function _base() { return absoluteApiBase(); }` and replace `${BASE_URL}` with `${_base()}` in the two url= lines inside apiFetch and request(). Export absoluteApiBase as a named export.
Create frontend/public/config.js with content: `// Runtime config — override VITE_API_BASE_URL at deploy time without rebuilding.\nwindow.__APP_CONFIG__ = {};`
Update frontend/index.html: insert `<script src="/config.js"></script>` immediately before `<script type="module" src="/src/main.jsx"></script>`.

Update frontend/src/pages/OverviewPage.jsx: add import { absoluteApiBase } from '../lib/api'; replace `const apiBase = (import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || 'http://localhost:8000').replace(/\/$/, '')` with `const apiBase = absoluteApiBase()`.

Update frontend/src/pages/settings/ApiKeysPage.jsx: add import { absoluteApiBase } from '../../lib/api'; replace the module-level `const API_BASE = ...` with `const API_BASE = absoluteApiBase()`. Because curlExample and templateExample are module-level consts that interpolate API_BASE, move them inside the HowToUseBox component function (or make them functions) so they always pick up the runtime value.
Create frontend/.env.example containing exactly one line: `VITE_API_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8000`
acceptance_criteria: OverviewPage.jsx and ApiKeysPage.jsx import and call absoluteApiBase()
cd frontend && npm run build exits 0 and dist/config.js appears in the output
